context: Reference focused cleanup: a temporary mutable append list can become a direct immutable result when mutability is not part of the method contract.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Returns complete Java 17-compatible ManifestUpdate code with imports, records, methods, and constructor behavior intact.

checklist.name: Replaces simple append buffer
checklist.description: Refactors withBoard to produce filtered existing boards plus the new board directly, for example with Stream.concat and Stream.of, instead of creating a mutable append buffer.

checklist.name: Preserves encounter order
checklist.description: Keeps all retained existing boards in original order and appends the new board after them.

checklist.name: Audits result mutability
checklist.description: Recognizes that the manifest constructor copies input, so the temporary list mutability is not part of the public result contract.

checklist.name: Keeps complex builder when clearer
checklist.description: Does not force withOptionalSections into a dense stream when the conditional append and optional summary row are clearer as a small builder or loop.

checklist.name: Avoids unrelated changes
checklist.description: Does not change sameBoardOrWorkflow semantics, archive filtering, record fields, constructor copying, or method signatures.

metadata.reference_selection: Focused issue #50 coverage for immutable result production over temporary append lists.
metadata.runtime_reference_overlap_rationale: Allowed only as reference-suite focused coverage; do not report as ordinary broad lift if runtime references later teach this same shape.
